summary: Iter38 — Verified Aceternity EncryptedText + Apple Cards Carousel on landing, Admin sessionStorage migration, and zero React key/unescaped-entities warnings. Backend smoke 6/6 PASS (health, admin login wrong/correct, admin overview, license-keys list). Frontend Playwright: 8/8 assertions PASS on landing (hero-headline scramble→final variant, 6× apple-card-0..5 rendered, carousel-next 0→360 scroll, carousel-prev returns to 0, modal opens with 'Leadership Coach' content + 'Wlads Sprache' bullet, ESC closes modal, 0 React key warnings, 0 unescaped-entities warnings, 0 console errors). Admin (/admin): login with wladhub2026 → token stored in sessionStorage['leaderos_admin_token'] ONLY, localStorage has NO admin token (migration confirmed). Tabs render (Overview/License Keys/Users/Transactions/Bookings/E-Mails), License Keys tab clicked & 62 keys table loaded. Only 2 cosmetic Recharts container-size warnings on admin (pre-existing, unrelated to this iteration).

issues: Recharts logs 2× 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings during initial mount — chart container has no min-height before data arrives. Cosmetic only, charts do render correctly after data loads.

action_items: Optional: add `minHeight:300` (or aspect ratio) to the Recharts ResponsiveContainer on the admin overview to silence the 2 chart-size warnings — purely cosmetic.
Ready for godmode deploy: ATF EncryptedText, 6-Agent Apple Cards Carousel, admin sessionStorage migration, and no React warnings are all green.
critical_code_review_comments: EncryptedText component (encrypted-text.jsx, 153 lines) — clean, RAF-driven, honors prefers-reduced-motion, supports mount/view/hover triggers, properly cancels animation on unmount. No issues.

apple-cards-carousel.jsx — faithful Aceternity port using framer-motion + IntersectionObserver-like keyboard cleanup. data-testid coverage solid (apple-card-{i}, carousel-prev, carousel-next). One observation: when modal is open, layoutId duplicates the motion.button so [data-testid='apple-card-N'] returns 2 elements for cards that are already mounted; .first selector handles it fine.

Hero.jsx (1039 lines) — APPROACHING the 700-line guideline ceiling. Consider extracting the 6-Agent section + headlines/audiences arrays into separate files for the next refactor pass. Not blocking for godmode but flagging.
Admin.jsx sessionStorage migration — verified working in browser, token only persists for tab lifetime as intended.
Carousel-prev correctly toggles disabled state via canScrollLeft — clicking prev at scrollLeft=0 is a no-op (intentional). Tested by scrolling next first (0→360) then prev (360→0).

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 — health, admin login wrong/correct, admin overview, license-keys)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 — encrypted-text scramble→final, 6 apple-cards, carousel-next, carousel-prev, modal-open, ESC-close, sessionStorage token, no localStorage token; 0 React key/unescaped warnings)

Data-testids: hero-headline, hero-headline-accent-N, hero-headline-line-N, agents-section, apple-card-0..5, carousel-prev, carousel-next, agents-headline-line-1/2. sessionStorage key for admin: 'leaderos_admin_token'. Backend smoke test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter38_smoke.py (6/6 pass in ~1.4s). Initial scrambled ATF text observed within first ~100ms (e.g., 'KI skT\\6-1* JO#KI*FDVH14'), final text resolves to one of the 5 A/B headline variants within 2.5s.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration. All requested features (EncryptedText decode effect, 6-Agent Apple Cards Carousel with click-to-modal, sessionStorage migration, no React key/unescaped warnings, backend health) verified working end-to-end on preview URL.
